name: Touch of Class Lounge
description: Touch of Class is a cozy neighborhood bar that offers a friendly and welcoming karaoke experience. It features karaoke nights on Tuesdays and Saturdays, with a fun, relaxed atmosphere that attracts a diverse crowd. The venue is known for its great music, strong drinks at affordable prices, and a community vibe where everyone feels at home. The staff is friendly and attentive, making it a perfect spot for casual karaoke nights and private gatherings alike.
